scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock'].forEach(f => { try { fs.rmSync(f); } catch {} });"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.render-build: pnpm --filter @workspace/task-manager run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
